fields.title: 📖 Hold Your Soul to Account
fields.body:
🖋️ Al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī, one of the Tābiʿīn, said in meaning:

“The believer **keeps watch over himself** and *holds himself accountable for the sake of Allah.*

The reckoning on the Day of Resurrection will be **easier** for those who *held themselves to account in this worldly life.*

**The reckoning will be harder**, however, for those who dealt with this matter *without self-examination.*”

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Nurturing the soul begins with sincere self-examination.** Whoever recognizes their mistakes, restrains their desires and holds themselves to account strives for **the purification of the soul** and obedience to Allah.
